headline: 🔴 Elementor Pro RCE flaw hits 6M WordPress sites, ⛓️ 5,400 sites serve ClickFix via blockchain, 🟠 Chrome V8 zero-day added to CISA KEV, 🎯 Qilin claims UK financial and Canadian construction targets, 🔶 Akira expands into Austrian manufacturing
